name: Editorial title card
purpose: Opening or section title: kicker, display title with optional <em>, hand-drawn underline and lede.

implementation.api: Studio.comp.titleCard(parent, {kicker, title|titleHTML, subtitle, underline}).enter(tl, at) / .exit(tl, at)

layout_notes: Fills the safe frame. Landscape and square: vertically centred; portrait: bottom-weighted above the caption zone. Title reflows by width; type scale per format comes from --fs-display.
validation_steps: npx hyperframes check on the render host

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test tests/test-studio-runtime.py and frame review of projects/masala-chai-recipe (landscape, portrait, square) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30. Not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the Apple M2 host, so not approved.
